Switch Google's mandatory cross-device QR verification back to standard 6-digit SMS / Voice verification on desktop browsers.

picks.name: yogurt
picks.description: Private AI meeting notes that stay on your computer. No meeting bot. Free and open source for Mac, Windows and Linux. An alternative to Granola, Otter and Fireflies.
picks.readmeHead:
Yogurt
Private AI meeting notes, with no bot in your call.
A free, open-source alternative to Granola, Otter and Fireflies.

Website · GitHub
## Introduction Yogurt records your microphone and call audio, then transcribes and summarizes on your Mac, Windows or Linux computer. It names speakers from Zoom, Teams and Meet and answers questions across meetings with sources. ## Why Our conversations should be our own business. Good notes shouldn't need third-party servers or an account. That's why we built Yogurt to record, transcribe and summarize on your computer. It goes online only to download models and check for updates. ## Download Yogurt is free for [Mac](https://github.com/FrigadeHQ/yogurt/releases/latest/download/Yogurt-mac-arm64.dmg), [Windows](https://github.com/FrigadeHQ/yogurt/releases/latest/download/Yogurt-windows-x64.exe) and [Linux](https://github.com/FrigadeHQ/yogurt/releases/latest/download/Yogurt-linux-x86_64.AppImage). On a Mac you can also use [Homebrew](https://brew.sh). ```sh brew install --cask frigadehq/yogurt/yogurt ``` ## What it does - **Live transcripts.** Yogurt records calls and turns speech into text as you talk. - **Meeting summaries.** Yogurt writes up the conversation and any notes you add. - **Private by default.** Your audio, transcripts and AI processing stay on your computer. - **

picks.name: chat-demo
picks.readmeHead:
# chat-demo

English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A static chat demo powered by the DeepSeek API. No application backend is required: the browser connects directly to the configured API service.

You can [try the app online](https://deepseek-ai.github.io/chat-demo/) or download the archive from [Releases](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-chat-demo/releases), extract it, and double-click `index.html` to use it locally without installation or a build. Enter your API key in Settings before your first chat.

## Getting started

Install Node.js 22.12+ and pnpm, then run:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/deepseek-ai/chat-demo.git
cd chat-demo
pnpm install
pnpm dev
```

Open http://localhost:8090.

To build the static site:

```sh
pnpm build
```

The output is written to `dist/`. Deploy it to a static web server or open `dist/index.html` directly. Opening the file directly requires browser support for storage on `file://` pages and an API service that permits their cross-origin requests.

## Features

- Multiple conversations with automatic titles, renaming, and deletion; edit prompts, regenerate replies, and switch between message branches.
- Streaming replies, deep thinking, smart search, link reading, and source citations; stop generation or continue eligible replies.
- Upload, paste, or drag and drop attachments; use voice input and read replies aloud. A live audio spectrum appears in the first row of the input area while recording on mobile.
- Markdown, syntax highlighting, KaTeX math, and Mermaid diagrams.
- Simplified Chinese and English, light and dark themes, mobile layouts, location settings, and chat history import and export.

## Data and storage

Your API key and settings are stored in the browser's localStorage. Conversations and original attachments are stored in IndexedDB. Local data is isolated by browser profile and site origin. # 拍片哥女装 · AI 服装参考图集 (COSTUME-DB-01)

一个深色主题的纯净服装参考图集网站，收录 **2727 套**（写实真人版 1407 套 + 二次元动漫版 1320 套）人物不入镜的 AI 生成纯服装图像（2:3 比例），支持中英文双语浏览、多维检索，并配备可选的 AI 一键换装试穿。

> 👗 **【Linux.do 3级常任理事专属彩蛋】**  
> 听说在 [LINUX DO](https://linux.do/) 社区只要升到 **3 级（常任理事）** 就可以解锁“看女装大佬”的保留节目？身为一名尊贵的 Linux.do 3 级老兵，逛了一圈发现坛里的女装资源还不够看，干脆亲手搓了这个 **「拍片哥女装」** 项目！  
> 不仅收录了写实与动漫双图库合计 2727 套纯净高质量服装图，还顺手接了 AI 虚拟换装后端——这下各位佬友哪怕现实中没有小裙子，直接传张自拍照就能一键无痛变身“女装大佬”出道了 😂！

> 🔗 **在线预览**：https://paipiange.github.io/nvzhuang/  
> ⭐ **GitHub 源码**：https://github.com/paipiange/nvzhuang  
> 📱 **Android APK 下载**：[GitHub Releases 直链](https://github.com/paipiange/nvzhuang/releases/latest/download/nvzhuang-release.apk)（[全部版本](https://github.com/paipiange/nvzhuang/releases)） | 也可[夸克网盘下载](https://pan.quark.cn/s/a914f76fac0b)（「拍片哥女装」`https://pan.quark.cn/s/a914f76fac0b`）  
> 👤 **AI 模特脸部与造型图库**：集成自 [ai-portrait-gallery](https://ai-portrait-gallery.pages.dev/)（あぎ @agi_aibusi · CC0 1.0）  
> 💃 **兄弟项目（AI 姿势参考与生图工坊）**：https://github.com/paipiange/ai-pose-gallery-zh  
> 💡 **原作者推文 / 灵感来源**：X [@giaaibusi](https://x.com/giaaibusi)  
> 🐧 **社区友链**：[LINUX DO (https://linux.do/)](https://linux.do/)

## ⏱️ 10 秒了解本项目

- 🆓 **免费使用（无需部署 / 无需 Key）**：三大图库一键无缝切换：**写实服装 (1407 套) + 动漫服装 (1320 套) + AI 模特库 (1499 位)**，支持分类筛选、中英双语双向检索、大图全屏查看、基础搭配台与同款跳转，由纯前端静态驱动，在线打开即可使用。
- 👤 **内置 1499 位 AI 模特（全量本地化）**：完整集成 CC0 1.0 授权的 AI 模特脸部特写与造型图库，AI 试衣时可直接一键挑选心仪模特，彻底告别“想体验换装却找不到合适人像照片”的困扰。

- 📜 **完全可商用 · 免费开源**：基于 [MIT License](LICENSE) 全量开源，代码与图集资源完全开放，支持自由商用创作、设计参考及二次开发。详见 [合规审计报告](docs/LINUXDO_RELEASE_AUDIT.md)。
